subject: Request to freeze funds and preserve records, Complaint NCRP-2026-0001
body:
To the Compliance / Law Enforcement Liaison Team,

A cyber-fraud complaint (NCRP-2026-0001) reports the loss of 12,000 USDT. Blockchain analysis indicates that 7,850 USDT was received at deposit address TAD47AKhQdrF4P8xpbVBx3GAr6Q56BFZJ3 (transaction e828262918d57d2cd7eed5839a5ecaf50c3ec8bfd06ebc65826455b7a55f8b97) and later swept to hot wallet TJ4imTmNr3FZoqR2jsRBuXS2aNXNAsAXhK.

We request that you (1) place a hold on the above funds and any related balances, and (2) preserve and share the KYC details, linked bank/UPI accounts, registered phone numbers, email addresses and login IP logs associated with this deposit address.

Attribution confidence: 87% (heuristic). Evidence is attached. Legal provision references: [TO BE FILLED BY OFFICER].

[Officer name / designation / contact]
